implementation: Native GtkCellRendererPixbuf owner already replaced the legacy raw pointer; this task strengthens tests and records acceptance.

sanitizers.reason: No new instrumented native build available; these results make no ASan/UBSan/LSan claim.

acceptance.initial_value: Native pixbuf property is NULL, default named icon is separately owned by GTK; fresh teardown before sizing is safe.
acceptance.failed_generation: Real missing-icon factory yields NULL/error, clearing fresh or populated renderer safely; empty draw leaves Cairo bytes unchanged.
acceptance.regeneration: Replacement, borrowed/getter-retained same value, explicit reset, named-icon recovery and new pixels preserve proper ownership.
acceptance.release_once: GdkPixbufDestroyNotify increments once for actual storage release at replacement/reset/final renderer release, survives a caller reference, and covers both column/handle owner orders.
acceptance.no_null_drawing: Inherited native measure/render of cleared image is empty in LTR/RTL and sensitive/insensitive states at scale 1 and 2.
acceptance.support_files: All four popupbutton/popupper files checked individually; none declares or owns this pixbuf, so native popup lifetime stays independent.

limits: Native GTK3 Linux Xvfb test execution, not physical input or cross-platform acceptance.
No new sanitizer/LSan run, allocator/OOM simulation, or exact legacy icon/shadow visual parity.
No production lifetime code change or artificial duplicate image owner.
privacy: Only TAP, non-sensitive result metadata, source/binary/log hashes and summarized diagnostics are retained; full environment and private display credentials are excluded.
